text.tspan: Per capita meat consumption by type World, 1961 to 2023
Per capita meat consumption is broken down by types of meat, and is measured in kilograms per person per

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)
Data does not include fish and seafood. Figures show meat supply and do not correct for waste at the household level and, so they may

text.tspan: not directly reflect the quantity of food consumed by a given individual.
